a.text: On the fourteenth of September, a man dressed in a bathrobe and dripping in sweat burst into my living room unannounced while we were watching the annual rerun of the sound of music. He had no shoes and a long scraggly beard.

b.text: I was about to say, as most self respecting commanders of their home would do, to be on his way and kick his arse with my shoe.

c.text: But at the very same moment I began to speak, and scream at his face to “listen here pipsqueak!”, he took his long finger and pressed it to my lips.

e.text: Into the sleeve of his robe he rummaged, until he produced a slightly damp letter, baking like the sun.
